Control_Description: This document specifies the requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining and continually improving an information security management system within the context of the organization. It also includes requirements for the assessment and treatment of information security risks tailored to the needs of the organization.
Audit_Steps_ToD: Verify if 'Scope' is documented and formally integrated into the ISMS scope.
Evidence_ToE: Review implementation evidence for 'Scope' — check logs, reports, or technical enforcement.

Control_Name: 4.1 - Understanding the organization and its context
Control_Description: The organization shall determine external and internal issues that are relevant to its purpose and that affect its ability to achieve the intended outcome(s) of its information security management system.
Audit_Steps_ToD: Verify if 'Understanding the organization and its context' is documented and formally integrated into the ISMS scope.
Evidence_ToE: Review implementation evidence for 'Understanding the organization and its context' — check logs, reports, or technical enforcement.

Control_Name: 4.2.a - Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties, part a)
Control_Description: The organization shall determine: a) interested parties that are relevant to the information security management system.
Audit_Steps_ToD: Verify if 'Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties, part a)' is documented and formally integrated into the ISMS scope.
Evidence_ToE: Review implementation evidence for 'Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties, part a)' — check logs, reports, or technical enforcement.

Control_Name: 4.2.b - Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties, part b)
Control_Description: The organization shall determine: b) the relevant requirements of these interested parties. Note: the requirements of interested parties  include legal and regulatory requirements and contractual obligations.
Audit_Steps_ToD: Verify if 'Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties, part b)' is documented and formally integrated into the ISMS scope.
Evidence_ToE: Review implementation evidence for 'Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties, part b)' — check logs, reports, or technical enforcement.

Control_Name: 4.2.c - Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties, part c)
Control_Description: The organization shall determine: c) which of these requirements will be addressed through the information security managment system
Audit_Steps_ToD: Verify if 'Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties, part c)' is documented and formally integrated into the ISMS scope.
Evidence_ToE: Review implementation evidence for 'Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties, part c)' — check logs, reports, or technical enforcement.

Control_Name: 4.3.a - Determining the scope of the information security management system, part a)
Control_Description: The organization shall determine the boundaries and applicability of the information system management system to establish its scope. When determining this scope, the organization shall consider: the external and internal issues referred to in 4.1 The scope shall be available as documented information.
Audit_Steps_ToD: Verify if 'Determining the scope of the information security management system, part a)' is documented and formally integrated into the ISMS scope.
Evidence_ToE: Review implementation evidence for 'Determining the scope of the information security management system, part a)' — check logs, reports, or technical enforcement.

Control_Name: 4.3.b - Determining the scope of the information security management system, part b)
Control_Description: The organization shall determine the boundaries and applicability of the information system management system to establish its scope. When determining this scope, the organization shall consider: the requirements referred to in 4.2. The scope shall be available as documented information.
Audit_Steps_ToD: Verify if 'Determining the scope of the information security management system, part b)' is documented and formally integrated into the ISMS scope.
Evidence_ToE: Review implementation evidence for 'Determining the scope of the information security management system, part b)' — check logs, reports, or technical enforcement.

Control_Name: 4.3.c - Determining the scope of the information security management system, part c)
Control_Description: The organization shall determine the boundaries and applicability of the information system management system to establish its scope. When determining this scope, the organization shall consider: interfaces and dependencies between activities performed by the organization, and those that are performed by other organizations. The scope shall be available as documented information.
Audit_Steps_ToD: Verify if 'Determining the scope of the information security management system, part c)' is documented and formally integrated into the ISMS scope.
Evidence_ToE: Review implementation evidence for 'Determining the scope of the information security management system, part c)' — check logs, reports, or technical enforcement.

Control_Description: The organization shall establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve an information security management system, including the processes needed and thier interactions, in accordance with the requirements of this International Standard.
